description: This PHP source file defines the AttendanceDao class, a Data Access Object for managing attendance records in the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management System. It contains methods for saving, retrieving, and checking attendance punch records, handling overlaps, generating attendance reports, and managing workflow configurations related to attendance states.

classes.name: AttendanceDao
classes.description: A Data Access Object class responsible for handling database interactions related to employee attendance records, including CRUD operations, overlap checks, report generation, and workflow configuration management within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: savePunchRecord
methods.description: Persists an AttendanceRecord object to the database and returns it.

methods.name: getLastPunchRecordByEmployeeNumberAndActionableList
methods.description: Retrieves the most recent punch record for a specified employee that is in a listed actionable state.

methods.name: checkForPunchOutOverLappingRecords
methods.description: Checks for overlapping punch out records for an employee, throws exception if overlaps or invalid timing are detected.

methods.name: checkForPunchInOverLappingRecords
methods.description: Checks for overlapping punch in records for an employee; throws exception if a punch-in already exists.

methods.name: checkForPunchInOverLappingRecordsWhenEditing
methods.description: Checks for overlaps when editing a punch in record, considering optional punch out time.

methods.name: checkForPunchInOutOverLappingRecordsWhenEditing
methods.description: Checks for overlaps between punch in and punch out times when editing an existing record.

methods.name: getCommonQueryForPunchOutOverlap
methods.description: Internal method to validate overlap scenarios for punch out times, considering existing records and optional record ID exclusion.

methods.name: getCommonQueryForPunchInOverlap
methods.description: Internal method to detect overlaps for punch in times, considering existing records and record ID exclusion.

methods.name: getCommonQueryForPunchInOverlap
methods.description: Checks for overlaps when a punch in time is inserted, considering existing records.

methods.name: hasSavedConfiguration
methods.description: Checks if a workflow configuration exists for a specific set of parameters, such as workflow, state, role, action, and resulting state.

methods.name: deleteAttendanceRecords
methods.description: Deletes attendance records with specified IDs from the database.

methods.name: getAttendanceRecordById
methods.description: Retrieves an attendance record by its ID, ensuring associated employee is not purged.

methods.name: getAttendanceRecordsByEmpNumberAndIds
methods.description: Retrieves multiple attendance records matching given employee number and record IDs.

methods.name: getLatestAttendanceRecordByEmployeeNumber
methods.description: Fetches the most recent attendance record for a given employee.

methods.name: getAttendanceReportCriteriaList
methods.description: Generates an attendance report as an array based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getAttendanceReportPaginator
methods.description: Returns a paginator object configured with a query for attendance report generation.

methods.name: getAttendanceReportCriteriaListCount
methods.description: Counts total entries in attendance report based on filters.

methods.name: getTotalAttendanceDuration
methods.description: Calculates total attendance time in seconds for a specified filter set.

methods.name: getAttendanceRecordList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of attendance records matching filter parameters with pagination.

methods.name: getAttendanceRecordListCount
methods.description: Counts the number of attendance records matching specified filters.

methods.name: getTotalWorkingTime
methods.description: Calculates total working time in seconds across filtered attendance records.

methods.name: getEmployeeAttendanceSummaryList
methods.description: Returns summarized attendance data for employees based on filters.

methods.name: getEmployeeAttendanceSummaryListCount
methods.description: Counts total summarized entries matching filters.
